description: Aménagement cyclable -Communauté d'agglomération de l'Albigeois is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération de l'Albigeois. This data provides information on the cycling developments of the Albigeois agglomeration Community (C2A) and in line with the national scheme. Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération de l'Albigeois. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling development -Agglomeration community of Albigeois" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'agglomération de l'Albigeois. Its keywords include reseau-cyclable, deplacements-doux, amenagement-cyclable, transports, albigeois, mobilites. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2024-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
